summary: Full auth-flow validation (backend + frontend) for Petito Google-auth + Mis creaciones + Admin allowlist. 14/14 backend pytest cases pass; 11/11 frontend scenarios pass at 390x844.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/auth/logout deletes the session_token row immediately. Any shared seed session used by both automated tests AND manual retests will be invalidated the first time a logout flow runs. Testing agents must re-seed after a logout test. Non-blocking.

GET /auth/me returns the same generic 401 'Inicia sesión para continuar' whether the token is missing OR invalid/expired. For debugging it would help to differentiate 'missing credentials' vs 'expired/revoked token'.
AuthProvider boots once on mount; after a cookie/localStorage swap the SPA must be reloaded to pick up the new session (expected, but worth noting in docs for QA).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Seeded sessions: test_session_norm_1 (normal user, user_testnorm1), test_session_admin_1 (admin, user_testadmin1). Michi portrait slug=39f1974e10. Frontend requires EITHER cookie 'session_token' (domain=cuentapatas-demo.preview.emergentagent.com, secure, sameSite=None) OR localStorage key 'petito_token'; sending both is safest. If you call POST /auth/logout against a shared token, re-seed it. Use add_init_script to set localStorage before first page load. AuthProvider reads /auth/me on mount, so change sessions via a fresh goto rather than in-page toggles.
